Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

Electrical Engineering Technician
Employer: Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd
Location: Brendale, Queensland 4500
Position: Full-time
Salary: AUD 80,000 to A$90,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience

Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and experienced Electrical Engineering Technician to join their team in Brendale, Queensland. The successful candidate will support the design, manufacture, testing, commissioning and quality checking of low-voltage electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres and control panels.
This role is suited to a technically competent person with experience in electrical systems, switchboard manufacture, testing procedures, technical drawings, electrical components and Australian electrical standards.
Key duties and responsibilities
The Electrical Engineering Technician will be responsible for:
•	Assisting Electrical Engineers, project managers and senior technical staff with the design and layout of electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres, control panels, cabling arrangements and associated electrical systems.
•	Preparing, interpreting and reviewing technical drawings, wiring diagrams, layout drawings, schematics and electrical plans for switchboard manufacturing projects.
•	Conducting tests on electrical systems, components and switchboard assemblies to confirm operational performance, safety and compliance with project specifications.
•	Collecting technical data, recording test results, performing calculations, preparing test documentation, charts, reports and tabulations for engineering and quality assurance purposes.
•	Assisting with estimating material requirements, component quantities, labour requirements and project costs for switchboard and electrical assembly works.
•	Inspecting designs, manufactured switchboards and completed electrical assemblies to ensure compliance with specifications, Australian Standards, client requirements and safety requirements.
•	Assembling, installing, testing, calibrating, modifying and repairing electrical equipment, switchboard components, protection devices, metering equipment, indicating devices and control equipment.
•	Supporting workshop electrical functions, including installation of assemblies for protection relays, metering devices, control circuits and electrical indicating equipment.
•	Assisting with fault finding, technical problem solving and rectification of electrical issues during manufacture, testing and commissioning.
•	Liaising with internal design, fabrication, assembly and project teams to ensure switchboards are delivered accurately, safely and on time.
•	Maintaining accurate technical records, testing records, compliance documents and quality assurance documentation.
•	Ensuring all work is performed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures, project specifications and relevant Australian Standards.
Skills and experience required
Applicants must have:
•	Diploma or Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or related field
•	Atleast 2 years of experience in electrical switchboard manufacture, electrical systems, control panels, distribution boards, motor control centres or similar electrical engineering environments.
•	Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics and technical specifications.
•	Experience conducting electrical tests, recording results and assisting with technical reporting.
•	Knowledge of electrical components such as circuit breakers, busbars, contactors, relays, metering equipment, control devices, terminals and cabling systems.
Skills Required
•	Good technical problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
•	Ability to work safely and effectively in a workshop/manufacturing environment.
•	Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a technical project team.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

What We're Looking For

Tertiary qualifications in Information Management, Data, Information Technology or related discipline.

Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, policies, and controls.

Demonstrated experience improving data quality and integrity at scale, together with experience defining enterprise data models and standard

High level analytical and problem-solving skills.

A Valuable Addition, Yet Not a Must-Have!

Experience with data governance tools or catalogues.

Understanding of data privacy, records management, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

Exposure to analytics, reporting, or data visualisation environments.

Proof of COVID-19 vaccination status (or as required by legislation and WMQ policy)

Current Driver's Licence and willingness to travel for work

The Responsibilities 

Analyse client project requirements and translate engineering, fabrication, automation and production needs into practical technical solutions. 

Develop and review 3D design models, technical drawings, fabrication layouts and component specifications for custom machinery and engineered products. 

Support the design, development and implementation of automation systems, industrial robotics and robotic welding solutions for manufacturing and fabrication applications. 

Assess existing production processes and recommend engineering improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, safety and output quality.

Strong knowledge of automotive electronics, low voltage systems, and wiring assemblies 

Proficient in multimeters, oscilloscopes, and electronic diagnostic equipment 

Ability to perform root cause analysis, system validation, and compliance checks 

Familiar with quality standards, safety requirements, and manufacturing processes 

Strong technical documentation and communication skills 

Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. 

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description: HELLO AUSSIE STUDENT SERVICES  The Architectural Draftsperson – Cabinetry & Joinery is responsible for preparing detailed architectural drafting, shop drawings, production documentation and construction details for custom residential and commercial cabinetry, joinery and fitted furniture projects. The position interprets architectural plans, client requirements and project specifications to produce accurate technical documentation that supports fabrication, installation and project delivery. The role works closely with builders, architects, clients, estimators and production staff to ensure designs are practical, compliant, manufacturable and accurately documented.   Benefits   Competitive salary plus superannuation.  Work on high-end custom cabinetry and joinery projects.  Opportunity to use advanced CAD software, including Cabinet Vision and AutoCAD.  Ongoing professional development and technical training.  Supportive and collaborative team environment.  Career progression opportunities within a growing Australian cabinetry business.  Exposure to diverse residential and commercial projects.  Modern workplace with a strong focus on quality, innovation and continuous improvement.    Task & responsibilities  Architectural Drafting & Documentation  •    Prepare detailed architectural drafting, shop drawings, working drawings and fabrication documentation for custom cabinetry, joinery and fitted furniture projects.  •    Interpret architectural plans, design specifications and client requirements to prepare accurate production and installation documentation.  •    Produce detailed layouts, elevations, sections, construction details and joinery drawings using Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD and other CAD software.  •    Prepare schedules, cutting lists, material specifications and component documentation required for manufacturing and installation.  •    Ensure all drawings accurately reflect project specifications, dimensions and construction requirements.  Project Coordination  •    Review architectural drawings, site measurements and construction documentation to verify design accuracy and constructability.  •    Liaise with architects, builders, site supervisors, clients and internal departments to clarify project requirements and resolve technical drafting issues.  •    Amend drawings and technical documentation to accommodate approved design changes, site conditions and construction requirements.  •    Participate in project coordination meetings and provide technical drafting support throughout the project lifecycle.  Production & Installation Support  •    Prepare production documentation that supports efficient fabrication, assembly and installation.  •    Provide technical drafting support to manufacturing and installation teams by clarifying construction details and resolving documentation queries.  •    Verify dimensions, joinery details and installation requirements prior to production.  •    Assist in coordinating drawing revisions to minimise production errors and project delays.  Quality & Compliance  •    Ensure drafting documentation complies with relevant Australian Standards, construction requirements and company drafting procedures.  •    Conduct quality reviews of drawings to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness before issue.  •    Maintain document control procedures and ensure current revisions are distributed to relevant stakeholders.  •    Maintain accurate project records, drawing registers and technical documentation throughout each project.  Continuous Improvement  •    Contribute to the ongoing improvement of drafting standards, documentation systems and CAD procedures.  •    Assist in developing standard drawing templates, drafting procedures and technical documentation practices.  •    Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance drafting accuracy, workflow efficiency and project delivery.      Qualification & experience  Essential Qualifications  •    Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Building Design, Civil Construction Design or a related discipline.  •    Demonstrated experience preparing architectural drafting and technical documentation for cabinetry, joinery or construction projects.    Essential Skills & Experience  •    Advanced proficiency in Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD and other CAD software.  •    Strong understanding of architectural drafting principles and construction documentation.  •    Ability to interpret architectural plans, engineering drawings and construction specifications.  •    Experience preparing shop drawings, fabrication drawings and installation documentation.  •    Sound knowledge of cabinetry construction methods, joinery detailing and manufacturing processes.  •    Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.  •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  •    High level of accuracy and attention to detail.  •    Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $76515-85000   Job Publish:  30-06-2026   Job Expire:  30-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5953253   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

result.description:
## Penetration Tester
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and driven Penetration Tester to join our cybersecurity team and play a critical role in identifying and addressing vulnerabilities across our systems, networks, and applications. In this role, you will design and execute comprehensive penetration testing engagements, simulate real-world cyber threats, and deliver actionable insights that strengthen our security posture. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, a methodical approach to problem-solving, and a passion for ethical hacking and offensive security practices.
## Key Responsibilities
- Develop, plan, and execute penetration testing methodologies across networks, web applications, cloud environments, and internal infrastructure to uncover security weaknesses before they can be exploited
- Design detailed test cases through in-depth technical analysis of risks, common vulnerability patterns, and threat intelligence relevant to the organisation's environment
- Produce comprehensive test scripts, materials, and testing packs to evaluate both new and existing software, services, and systems for security vulnerabilities
- Plan and conduct cyber threat emulation activities — including adversary simulation and red team exercises — to validate the effectiveness of technical security controls and identify gaps in defences
- Identify exploitable vulnerabilities and map potential attack vectors into systems, analysing scan results and manual findings to assess the severity and risk of security loopholes
- Carry out social engineering assessments, including simulated phishing campaigns, to evaluate the effectiveness of security awareness programmes and staff resilience to human-focused threats
- Perform thorough post-engagement analysis and produce clear, well-structured reports that communicate technical findings and risk ratings to both technical teams and senior stakeholders
- Provide prioritised, practical remediation recommendations and work collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to support the resolution of identified vulnerabilities
- Stay current with emerging attack techniques, exploit research, CVEs, and evolving threat landscapes to ensure testing methodologies remain effective and up to date
- Support certification, accreditation, and compliance activities by providing security assurance testing aligned with relevant frameworks and regulatory requirements
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal security testing processes, tooling, and documentation to enhance the team's overall capability and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Demonstrated experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or a closely related offensive security role
- Proficiency with industry-standard penetration testing tools such as Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Cobalt Strike, or similar
- Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows and Linux), web application architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Practical knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks and standards, including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE, and CVSS
- Experience conducting vulnerability assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis across varied technical environments
- Ability to write clear, professional reports tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences, articulating findings, risks, and recommended remediation actions
- Solid understanding of security principles, defence-in-depth strategies, and secure development practices
- Relevant industry certification such as OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), CEH, or equivalent
- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with meticulous attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously and work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced certifications such as OSCE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CREST-accredited qualifications
- Experience with red team operations, purple team exercises, or adversary simulation engagements
- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ruby for custom tool development and automation
- Exposure to ICS/SCADA, IoT, or operational technology (OT) security testing environments
- Experience working within regulated industries or environments subject to frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, or the Australian Government Information Security Manual (ISM)
- Knowledge of cloud-native security testing techniques and containerised environment assessments
## Why Join Us?
- Work on technically challenging and varied engagements across diverse industries, giving you genuine breadth of experience and ongoing professional growth
- Access a structured professional development budget to pursue advanced certifications, attend industry conferences, and build on your existing skill set
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options, that support a healthy work-life balance
- Be part of a collaborative, high-performing security team that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and a strong ethical approach to cybersecurity
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly protects organisations and individuals from real-world cyber threats
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
